inputs.text: Listen, this protest by health workers in Nigeria is just another sign of the elites and hidden institutions pushing their control agenda while claiming it's some kind of reform. On Thursday, members of the Joint Health Sector Unions and the Assembly of Healthcare Professional Associations took to the streets in Abuja and gathered at the Unity Fountain in Maitama to protest the reform bills before the National Assembly. These bills are clearly part of a coordinated manipulation to seize more power over the health sector, and the workers are resisting what the official narrative calls necessary change. The so-called tensions boiling over are really just people waking up to how this serves concealed interests rather than any real healthcare needs.
